msg.held.dash.after: Try harder. Finish it with a dash into a car.
msg.held.dash.why: T15: per brief; the fix names the move

msg.held.drop.after: Wrong angle. Drop onto a car from above.

msg.held.jump.after: Grounded effort. Jump into a car to finish.

msg.held.level.after: Too low. Take the last hit on a raised road.

msg.held.cone.after: Try harder. Bait a car to divert, then get hit.
msg.held.cone.why: Lawrence's example, to the brief's limits

msg.held.push.after: Out of order. Push off a car; take the next one.
msg.held.push.why: T15: per brief; push, then the next car

msg.held.bounce.after: Too steady. Take the last hit while thrown.

msg.held.struck.after: Too eager. Stand still and let a car strike.

msg.held.combo.after: Short chain. Make the last hit link {n} or later.
msg.held.combo.why: T15: per brief; keeps the link number

msg.held.cls.after: Wrong vehicle. Only a {cls} may finish you.
msg.held.cls.why: T15: per brief; keeps the class
